tagline: 柯尼卡便携相机，1982 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1982年推出的便携相机。配备Konica Hexanon 2.8/38mm, 4 elements in 3 groups。快门速度programmed shutter, three shutter speeds: 1/60, 1/125 and 1/250 s。使用Auto winding system (approx 1.3 fps), rewinding must be started manually。感光度ASA 25 to 400, to be set manually (no DX-code)。passive Visitronic AF system by Honeywell, nearest focus distance 1.1 m。

specs.Camera-wiki: Konica C35 MF and C35 MF-D
specs.对焦: passive Visitronic AF system by Honeywell, nearest focus distance 1.1 m
specs.快门: programmed shutter, three shutter speeds: 1/60, 1/125 and 1/250 s
specs.曝光测光: from EV 9 (f/2.8 at 1/60 s) to EV 17 (f/22 at 1/250) with ASA 100
specs.感光度: ASA 25 to 400, to be set manually (no DX-code)
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto winding system (approx 1.3 fps), rewinding must be started manually
specs.闪光灯: GN 14 (ASA 100, meter), range 1,1 to 5 m, daylight synchro feasible, switched on/off manually
specs.尺寸: 141 x 74.5 x 54 mm, 440 g without batteries
specs.电池: 2 x 1.5 V Mignon cells (no NiCd cells)
